answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks through multi-vantage latency triangulation. Verifiers broadcast cryptographic echo probes to benchmark response times against a network coordinate atlas. An adversary incurs the scarce cost of leasing distinct physical hardware across separate locations, whether in an urban center or a remote tundra outpost, preventing cheap local replication. However, routing jitter can skew delay measurements, unfairly penalizing honest distant agents.
